listitem.para:
The left participant's public key for signature (either RSA, ECDSA or EdDSA) authentication. The leftpubkey is the generic option. The key should be in base-64 encoded RFC 2537 format (with 0s prepended), or one of the following:
%none
the same as not specifying a value (useful to override a default)
%dnsondemand
(the default) the key is to be fetched from DNS at the time it is needed.
%dns
Treated as %dnsondemand. The identity used for the left participant must be a specific host, not %any or another magic value.
%cert
the information required from a certificate defined in %leftcert and automatically define leftid for you
Additionally, one can provide: a DER-encoded public key, or a raw public key generated using ipsec {rsasig,ecdsa,eddsa}key command.

caution.para: If two connection descriptions specify different public keys for the same leftid, confusion and madness will ensue.
